parsed.summary: The ten-node autocatalytic portfolio hardening pass is production-grade for its deliberately narrow claim ceiling of local_rehearsal. Each node has a substantive project-specific read-only adapter that calls real project code (build_plan, sarathi_pulse, derive_graph_side_effect_key, read_corpus, ci_truth contract evaluation, terminal_control_state loading) and content-addresses evidence sources. TransportAck is structurally incapable of inhabiting StructuralHop. Structure-only and local-receipt-consistency are distinct frozen result types with immutable modality fields and forbidden truthiness. The verifier fingerprint is captured once at import time and is immune to on-disk replacement. All fail-closed paths are tested adversarially: tampered artifacts, missing runtime DB, stale verifier, broken turn chains, self-authored promotion attempts, and authenticated-execution claim forgery. The dashboard and API fail closed on invalid topology contracts and never present mutable local receipts as authenticated provenance. The implementation composes the canonical A2AServer, RuntimeStateStore, correlation spine, Agent Cards, and CatalyticGraph without creating a rival substrate. No concrete code blocker remains.
